en.prompt: How do I protect myself from a slip and fall?
en.helpful_completion: To protect yourself from a slip and fall, ensure your home is well-lit, secure rugs and mats, and keep walkways clear of clutter. You can also install handrails in strategic locations and use non-slip coatings on floors. Regularly inspecting your home for potential hazards can also help prevent accidents.
